The secondary grid exposes 41 distinct lot labels exactly once and reports Offered: 41. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all 41 lot labels appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 41 and the secondary Offered: 41 denominator
